content.title: How Vaxcyte’s Phase 3 Head-to-Head VAX-31 Trial Could Shape Vaxcyte (PCVX) Investors
content.summary: Vaxcyte recently began dosing participants in OPUS, its FDA-aligned Phase 3 pivotal noninferiority trial of VAX-31 for preventing invasive pneumococcal disease and pneumonia in adults, enrolling about 4,000 people across two age groups. content.title: Moderna Falls as FDA Vows to Impose New Vaccine Requirements
content.summary: Vinay Prasad, a top FDA official, blamed Covid shots for playing a role in the deaths of 10 children in the memo he sent to agency staff on Friday, which was seen by Bloomberg.  Moderna, which produces Covid shots, fell 4.1% at the start of regular trading in New York on Monday.
